name: Research Workspace
description: A cited workspace for finding, connecting, and reusing knowledge.
goals: Improve retrieval quality and make research easier to reuse.

core_ideas.name: Evidence-linked memory
core_ideas.description: Recall should preserve provenance and expose conflicts instead of manufacturing certainty.

core_ideas.name: Connected knowledge
core_ideas.description: Projects, concepts, research, and sources become more useful through explicit relationships.

name: Support Assistant
description: An assistant that helps a team resolve customer questions safely.
goals: Reduce response time without lowering answer quality.

core_ideas.name: Grounded answers
core_ideas.description: Responses should cite approved help material and be honest when evidence is missing.

core_ideas.name: Human review at consequential steps
core_ideas.description: Automation can prepare work while people retain control over consequential actions.
